title: When Claims Evolve: Evaluating and Enhancing the Robustness of Embedding Models Against Misinformation Edits
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of embedding models used in fact-checking against misinformation claim edits like typos, casing, and dialect changes. While it includes a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section mentioning that an LLM refused to process claims with religious or political sensitivity, the core research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems.
